tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the KeelTools directory of AI tools, Skills and prompts. Matches name, slug, aliases and taglines. Returns type, slug, name, tagline and page URL.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get structured details for one entry by type and slug: tagline, pricing model, features, use cases, pros, cons and FAQ. Use search_directory first to find the slug.
